AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Animal Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beekeeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.

4. D — Glucose and oxygen

5. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

7. C — 100 °C

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

10. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. A — newton (N)

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
